answer: Newcomers earn nothing until two unrelated auditors watch one useful job done live at the same moment from two angles — a nebula parallax check — each staking 3 POA it was real. The job is keyed to a fresh river challenge, so it cannot be pre-recorded. The newcomer posts a 7 POA karst bond per pair; the nth identity from one wallet needs n simultaneous pairs, so the 1st fake pays 7 POA and the 10th 700 POA — no operator can do ten live jobs at once; a mismatch slashes the bond.
